title: RLX: A Unified Multi-Backend Tensor Compiler and Distributed Runtime in Rust
abstract: arXiv:2609.37916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Production machine learning (ML) stacks often split graph compilation and kernel execution across different layers and languages, making backend behavior, deployment guarantees, and performance fallbacks hard to reason about end-to-end. RLX addresses this gap with a single Rust codebase that combines compiler and runtime roles around one primitive-level, three-level intermediate representation (IR), plus a transparent dispatch contract that resolves each operator to native, common-IR, or rewritten lowering and fails compilation when legalization is not possible. The same IR targets fourteen runtime devices (cpu, metal, mlx, ane, cuda, rocm, oneapi, tpu, hexagon, gpu, vulkan, opengl, directx, webgpu) and two specialty codegen paths (Cortex-M INT8 and FPGA), ingests safetensors, GGUF, ONNX, and rten formats, supports F16/BF16/F64/C64 and quantized INT4/INT8 flows with AMP/PTQ/QAT, and scales via tensor-/pipeline-parallel collectives over

translated_title: RLX：基于 Rust 的统一多后端张量编译器与分布式运行时
translated_abstract: 生产级机器学习（ML）技术栈通常将图编译与内核执行分散在不同的层和语言中，导致后端行为、部署保证和性能回退难以进行端到端推理。RLX 通过单一的 Rust 代码库弥补了这一缺口：该代码库围绕一个原语级的三层中间表示（IR）将编译器与运行时角色结合在一起，并提供透明的分发契约，将每个算子解析为原生实现、公共 IR 或重写式降低，当合法化不可行时编译即告失败。同一 IR 可面向十四种运行时设备（cpu、metal、mlx、ane、cuda、rocm、oneapi、tpu、hexagon、gpu、vulkan、opengl、directx、webgpu）以及两条专用代码生成路径（Cortex-M INT8 和 FPGA），支持导入 safetensors、GGUF、ONNX 和 rten 格式，支持 F16/BF16/F64/C64 以及配合 AMP/PTQ/QAT 的量化 INT4/INT8 流程，并通过张量/流水线并行集合通信实现扩展。
tldr: RLX 在单一 Rust 代码库中围绕统一的三层原语级 IR 融合了编译器与分布式运行时，支持 14 种运行设备、多种模型格式与量化流程，实现了从图编译到执行的全栈端到端可推理部署。
en_tdlr: RLX unifies graph compilation and kernel execution in a single Rust codebase built on one primitive-level three-level IR, targeting 14 runtime devices, multiple model formats, and quantized flows for end-to-end, fully reason-able deployment.
